title: The Number of Isomorphism Classes of Beauville Surfaces with Beauville $p$-Group
summary: A Beauville surface is a rigid complex surface of general type, isogenous to a higher product by the free action of a finite group $G$, called a Beauville group. In \cite{GT}, González-Diez and Torres-Teigell find the number of isomorphism classes of Beauville surfaces for which the group $G$ is $\PSL(2,p)$ with particular types of `Beauville structures'. On the other hand, in \cite{GJT}, González-Diez, Jones and Torres-Teigell give an explicit formula for this number when the group $G$ is abelian.
